mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or correlation coefficient < -0.3 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating labor market strength) and low UNRATE (below 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 30% of 'goldilocks' zone instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of quarters with declining INDPRO, or correlation coefficient > -0.2 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating increased retail sales, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days due to strengthened consumer spending.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 25% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of high FEDFUNDS (> 4%) and low CPIAUCSL growth (< 2% YoY) creates a unique monetary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 35% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE (below 4.5%) without corresponding PAYEMS growth indicates labor market inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent HOUST growth (> 5% YoY) in the absence of significant GDPC1 revisions indicates sustainable housing-led demand, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of triggered instances, or correlation coefficient < 0.3 over any 5-year rolling window.
